user.title: Add a room
user.description: ThermalTwin learns how this room heats up and cools down from your existing sensors. Nothing is controlled - it creates prediction and advice entities you can use in automations.

data.name: Room name
data.weather_entity: Weather entity for the hourly forecast (optional)
data.use_sun: Learn the sun's effect from its position

data_description.target_temperature: Time-to-target predictions refer to this temperature, e.g. 19 °C as lower limit in winter or 28 °C as upper limit in a hot climate.
data_description.hvac_entity: Periods with heating or cooling are learned separately. IR units without feedback (SmartIR, Broadlink) are supported: periods where the room already sits at the setpoint are skipped so the real pull-down capacity is learned.
data_description.hvac_type: Cooling for air conditioners, heating for radiators and heat pumps in heating mode.
data_description.window_sensors: Periods with an open window or door are ignored for learning.
data_description.comfort_max: Upper comfort limit. Enables the ventilation advice and the comfort band of the card.
data_description.indoor_humidity: Adds dew point, absolute humidity, feels-like temperature and the dry-mode advice.
data_description.outdoor_humidity: Lets the ventilation advice check whether outside air would bring in more moisture. Taken from the weather entity when the outdoor temperature comes from one.
data_description.humidity_max: Above this relative humidity dry mode is recommended instead of cooling.
data_description.weather_entity: Predictions then follow the forecast outdoor temperature instead of assuming it stays constant.
data_description.power_sensor: The most reliable way to know when the compressor really runs. Adds runtime, energy and efficiency.
data_description.ready_by: The twin plans when the unit has to start so the room reaches the ready temperature at this time every day, e.g. bedtime.
data_description.ready_temperature: Temperature the room should have at the ready time. Defaults to the target temperature.
data_description.use_sun: Used when no solar sensor is set. Helps rooms that heat up in the afternoon sun.

error.same_entity: Indoor and outdoor entity must be different.

abort.already_configured: This indoor sensor already has a ThermalTwin.
